notes.content:

Hello, GLASS fans!

Since we launched the GLASS series, we've received a lot of requests from our fans.

One request stood out to us.
They wanted us to create a separate game where they could just enjoy the story and world of GLASS.

So we did! We made it! Memories of Glass Maiden!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695960/Memories_of_Glass_Maiden/

Released today, Memories of the Glass Maiden (MOG) contains the story of GLASS 2.
We'll continue to update it with stories from GLASS 1 and private stories as well.

Please visit MOG when you want to immerse yourself in the GLASS world!

We look forward to seeing you in the future.

Thank you.

notes.title: G-Magazine Issue 2 - February 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/02f31d25f2b65388be8d4d52cf94f340cbd7d91e.png[/img]

Greetings, GLASS fans!

This is the second issue of G-Magazine, and it's full of new game development news.

First, we're excited to announce the upcoming release of GLASS2 Part 2.
New heroines! A looming crisis! An unsolved mystery!!!
What? Don't get too excited?
But it's so much fun to make!
Please look forward to GLASS2 Part 2!

The second piece of news is the development of a new title.
It's tentatively called "Project B". 
The game is a secret, but it's about a vacation for a glass hunter who's tired of working... Lighthearted escapism and romance on vacation...
I'll leave it at that.

The third piece of news is the development of a new game too!
The third game will be in the visual novel genre.
This is a new genre for us.
We're working hard to impress our fans.

We're a small team, but your love is what keeps us going.

We look forward to your continued interest and support!

Thank you.

notes.title: Someting about GLASS2!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/88de152dee72d0e2d8b7a9f5dbdb81436c66be43.jpg[/img]

Since the news that Glass 2 is in production, Glass users have been asking a lot of questions. 
TeamSnowball, the production company, conducted a one-on-one interview with prof. MoonBillion, the general production manager, to help users answer their questions.

Q: First of all, could you introduce yourself?

A: We're the predecessor, or should I say predecessor.　I was the director of Project Glass at TeamSnowball, a multinational team. I'm still 
production, planning, and AD for Glass 2. My old nickname was 月天先生, now Prof. MoonBillion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/b62887f7f5c69cc444a188223d4c03643609b1f2.png[/img]

Q: The news of Glass 2, the sequel to Glass, has many players excited. From the brief information released, it seems that the game will be very large. In particular, the scenario of more than 100,000 characters stands out, does this mean that it is a story-oriented game?

A: When we made the previous game, Glass, the overall worldview of the glass world was established. 
However, since the game concept of Glass was a very casual game, we focused on the smallest unit of the world, the story of each character, rather than the development based on the world. However, in Glass 2, we wanted to introduce users to the world of Glass in earnest. Why the world of Glass came to be. We wanted to increase the understanding and immersion of the game by showing the stories of each of the female heroines trapped in the glass world and their intertwined stories. Naturally, the amount of scenarios increased, and the production cost became very high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/28647a7a5621390f77245f4080a8a6ab85374e58.jpg[/img]

Q: I understood this to mean that you wanted to tell a story based on the world of the Glass World. Is this the same reason why you abandoned the first-person perspective of the first movie and tried a third-person perspective with a protagonist named Aaron?

A: The hedonist class, which is responsible for rescuing the Glass Maiden who is trapped in a glass cage, was planned from the beginning, but in the previous game, Glass, we tried to leave this role to the user. However, in order to convey the scenario of the worldview of Glass 2, which is the production direction of Glass 2, we thought that a character with a pre-established image of a hedonist and an erotic was necessary rather than a colorless and odorless protagonist.
This is something that our Chinese writer MIGUO-kun has been advocating for a long time.  Aaron, who appears in this role, has already established stats and personality. His stats and personality are already established. Players will be able to make him behave in their own way with a bit of optional progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/5b9e66ec2adfae3c5df89a4b27ad686d4f27def2.jpg[/img]

Q: The voice actors involved in the production seem to have impressive credentials. 

A: We have a lot of scenarios, and the dialog between characters makes up over 90% of it. For the basic premise of telling the story, full voice was not an option, but a necessity. Full voice is very expensive, but we wanted to use proven voice actors to elevate Glass 2 to a higher level. HONEY BOMB, a company we've worked with for many years, was a great help. The voice recording process went smoothly without any hiccups or issues, and we were very pleased with the results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/5bf247302b6ccb41d248e3019392b1cdc39023cc.jpg[/img]

Q: I'm sure there will be different gameplay to meet the female heroines and glass maidens, but has the gameplay changed at all?

A: It can be said that we tried to make a big change in the gameplay. We chose to use solitaire gameplay, an element that hasn't been done before in similar genres. Most of the people who make games of this type try to avoid putting a lot of stress on the user, and this has become a common perception among game developers in this genre. In the early planning stages of Glass 2, this concern was raised and casual huddle games such as picture matching and three-match puzzles were considered, but in the end, Snowball chose solitaire. What we were most concerned about was the fusion of puzzle games with the essentials of H-games, and consideration for users who have never played this type of game before.We also paid a lot of attention to the H play aspect, whereas in the previous game you could only watch the heroine's desires, this time you can actively participate in them, (Many thanks to the development team for their hard work) and "that element" that many users wanted was also included! (Laughs)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/9b46d633b42d7853680376989d0e1325980527c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/1957585b9f42d04b515f7c9e43809860e05df63a.jpg[/img]


Q: This is the most important question. How faithful were you to your original role?

A: Thank you for your question. We spent the most development time with the illustrators who worked on the previous game, Glass, as well as new illustrators. Top-notch animators brought it to life. It's probably fair to say that we put the most effort into it since it's a game of its genre. For Glass 2, we used the best animators and directors, and this time we had a specialist who was only responsible for conceiving and directing the scenes. He has been immersed in the genre for more than 40 years and provided us with many nods and ideas, which I think helped us achieve a higher level of quality.(This is the guy who wrote this interview, the silly guy who says there's no one more knowledgeable than him when it comes to sex positions. But he was so helpful that I'm going to affectionately refer to him as RSM - Real Sex Machine.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/c218a986d12b20d6f96346f9091e2b3d089e91c5.jpg[/img]

Q: What would you say to the many users who are looking forward to Glass 2?

A: With our own IP, we've made a game that people say was a masterpiece. I want to make a game that is praised by users. We started making this game with the idea that it was a great game. That's not to say that we didn't put our heart into the previous game, but the environment to make the game was slightly better than then, such as production costs and development period. That is to say. I hope you will look forward to it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2392760/2/

[b][u]Eily Brave[/u][/b]

Police officers who travel around the universe and catch all kinds of vicious criminals. 
That is the space Cop. Unlike when we used to work only in narrow areas, portal technology has now become more popular. The means of safe arrest of a vicious criminal is complete, and the police are no longer just working in the village. 
It traveled all over the universe to prevent criminal activity.
Eily is also one of those police officers. But a new cop, Eily, always makes mistakes. 
Especially in front of violent criminals, it is hard to move and miss them in front of their nose.
However, Eily is not incompetent. Just because of her rightful personality, she's the only one who finds space lost. 
He has been decorated and prevented war between ships. Only in front of the clumsiness of men."
It's just getting powerless.
The reason is simple. Eily denies it, but she's being reckoned with by men who are vicious. 
Because I had a desire to want to do it. 
She couldn't do anything because she mistook the imagination for fear herself.
Even today, She was scolded by her bosses. Eily wakes up from the glass world after falling asleep in a depressed mood.

[u][b]Interview with Eily - CV: Hanyuumi [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39085879/74eb5f638a6e8e0e00899afe27cb4442aefd2116.png[/img]

1. Please introduce yourself.
This is Hanyu Umi. I mainly put out works for "adults".
Personally, I like the surname "Hanyu" because it has a cute sound.

2. Please tell me the appearance work
I think there are many games such as "Otogi Frontier" and "Lost Noah".
I also do situations such as "Mature woman earpick-neighbor's busty mature woman is my mom".

3. What is the biggest attraction of the character you were in charge of with GLASS?
Eily is a little unconfident in herself, but I like the feeling that she has a glimpse of some of the strong points, such as working hard on her work.

4. What steps do you take to increase your immersiveness when recording? 
At the time of recording, I am immersive or nervous, so I take my favorite milk-based drink to calm me down so that I can relax as much as possible. 

5. What if you would like to introduce a game that you recently enjoyed, a movie that you saw interesting, or an anime? 
I'm addicted to Hypnosismic lately. I'm enjoying the world of HIPHOP including rap ♪ Anime is also being broadcast and I laugh every week (lol) 

6. What type of cast do you want to play? 
I would like to try something like a little devil sister. I always have a relaxed attitude, but I also like characters that are clumsy or have a cute human touch.

7. Where would you like to travel when peace returns to the world?
I want to take the plunge and go abroad. I would like to see the streets of England and Europe. I think the cityscape at Christmas time seems to be fun ♪

8. What are your tips and hobbies that you would like to introduce in your recent life?
I have more opportunities to stay at home this year, so I'm addicted to muscle training and stretching that I can do during my time at home. After exercising, I feel refreshed and feel very good.

9. Is there anything memorable about this work?
Some of the staff members were present remotely for this recording, and it was a greeting through the camera. It was a little fresh ♪

10. Finally, a word to the users.
Thank you for playing "GLASS"!
Eily is a little unconfident, but I think she's cute too. There are other wonderful girls, so please love them all. Thank you for watching so far ♪
